notes:
# v1.4.0 — a faster app, honest storage numbers, and two new novel sources

- New: two more English web-novel providers, ReadNovelFull and NovelFull, join
  the library. Both live in a fresh "Web Novels" tab in the Home → Novels
  section, so browsing them feels just like the sources you already know.
- New: a real Storage Dashboard in Settings. It shows what the app actually
  takes up on your device — the local database, offline downloads, app logs and
  update bundles — with two new buttons: "Clear App Cache" (server caches only)
  and "Clean Up Orphans", which removes leftover download folders that no longer
  belong to anything in your library.
- Fixed: cached data no longer sticks around forever. Saved server responses now
  expire after 24 hours and expired ones are swept on startup, the "Reset Cache"
  button clears them too, and the home feed refreshes at least every 30 minutes
  instead of showing a stale list. The in-memory cache now measures real payload
  size, so its numbers mean something.
- Improved: everything loads faster. Providers reuse connections, chapter
  details are fetched in small pooled batches instead of all at once, database
  saves write once per batch, search results stream more smoothly, and long
  chapter lists render the first 300 rows with a "Show all N chapters" expander.
- Note: fonts load without blocking the page, so text and images appear sooner.
